intro: Courts, county clerks, and state agencies in Arizona are holding funds belonging to former property owners and residents. RCG monitors all 15 Arizona counties and recovers these funds at no upfront cost.

body.title: Recovery in Arizona. All 15 Counties.
paragraphs: Maricopa, Pima, and Pinal counties account for the majority of Arizona foreclosure surplus cases. Arizona trustee sales and tax lien certificate auctions frequently generate overages held by the county treasurer or superior court.

The Arizona Department of Revenue Unclaimed Property Division holds millions in dormant accounts, insurance proceeds, and other assets belonging to Arizona residents. RCG searches all Arizona superior court records and state unclaimed property databases for every Arizona client.
body.callout: Claims are filed through our network of licensed attorneys in Arizona. All recoveries are handled on a pure contingency basis with no upfront cost to the client.

lists.title: All 15 Arizona Counties.
lists.intro: RCG monitors foreclosure surplus funds, tax sale overages, and unclaimed property across every county in Arizona. If funds exist in your name in any Arizona county, we will find them and recover them.

footerLine: Trustee sale surplus · Tax lien certificate overages · Arizona unclaimed property · Estate and heir recovery · Excess proceeds from court sales, available across all 15 Arizona counties.
